<PLOT_SUMMARY>
In a post-apocalyptic Seoul, Nam-san, a relentless and formidable wasteland hunter, along with his loyal friend Choi Ji-wan and other survivors, are struggling to endure a harsh existence in their humble village. Nam-san and Ji-wan navigate the desolate wastelands, diligently scavenging for essential resources to sustain their struggling community. Trouble ensues when Su-na, a young girl from their village, is kidnapped by a rogue scientist, Dr. Yang Gi-su, who has been illegally experimenting with the aim of making humans immortal by injecting them with a specific serum, a process that has tragically led to the deaths of many teenagers. It is revealed that Gi-su had been conducting these experiments with the desperate intention of reviving his beloved daughter So-yeon, who had passed away around the same time Seoul transformed into a desolate wasteland. Gi-su needed more supplies for the serum and had established a clandestine network to procure more abducted teenagers for his illicit camp, which was situated within an abandoned apartment complex. Nam-san, Ji-wan, and Lee Eun-ho, a military sergeant stationed at the camp, discover Gi-su's horrific experiments and immediately embark on a mission to rescue Su-na. Nam-san, Ji-wan, and Eun-ho arrive at the camp and engage in a fierce battle with the mutant soldiers guarding the facility. They manage to rescue Su-na, while Gi-su escapes with So-yeon's body concealed in a suitcase. However, his escape is short-lived as he is soon surrounded by a furious mob of people, enraged by his actions and prepared to exact their own brutal justice. While shooting at the jeering crowd, Nam-san accidentally damages the suitcase, tragically resulting in So-yeon's death. Ultimately, Nam-san kills Gi-su and returns to his village, bringing Su-na and Ji-wan back to safety.
